title: fix(spec): tombstones for keys live in @objectstack/spec 17.7.0 name 18 as their removal version
body:
Fixes #23145
Clause-②: no (prescription text only: no key, value or shape is accepted or refused differently)

**Block lifted.** `check:future-spec-major` went green when the Version Packages pull request #21988 merged and `packages/spec/package.json` read `18.0.0-next.0`.

## Fix round (seat notes 6144192235 and 6144323612)

- **Why.** `main` gained two `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'` entries after the last merge. Unjoined, they trip the pin's completeness guard; on the previous head CI's `Test Core (1/6)` failed in `packages/spec` `pnpm run test` (its annotation; the job log is not readable from this container). `main` also gained a string of this class, `view.data.provider: 'api'` "removed in @objectstack/spec 17" (`1912af47b`, D3-only).
- **Joined.** `page-action-row-navigation-executor-to-url`: the `'navigation'` refusal on all four row shapes. `cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted`: the parse's refusal at `sharingModel`.
- **Corrected** (text only; the literal pins follow):
  - The `'navigation'` refusal named no release. It now says the alias is "refused on page action rows since @objectstack/spec 18".
  - The controlled-by-parent refusal named no release. It now says "ADR-0055 §1: since @objectstack/spec 18, …".
  - `view.data.provider: 'api'` now says "removed in @objectstack/spec 18".
  - The two-master refusal (same function, not on the D2 entry's surface) is unedited and names no release.
- **Measured liveness** (parse probes against each tarball, controls accepted):
  - all three shapes, including every `controlled_by_parent` variant (no master, optional master, required lookup, two masters), are **accepted** by 17.7.0 and by **18.0.0-next.0**;
  - the HEAD build refuses each one with its prescription.
  - So the changeset names next.0 only for its first table. These three rows sit in a second table: `18.0.0-next.0` still accepts them, so the first release that refuses them is the one after it.
- **Release pins.** `view-data-api-provider-retirement.test.ts` pins "@objectstack/spec 18"; `view.test.ts` and `object-storage.test.ts` gain one line each.
- **Pending-changeset quotes, corrected in place.** `23082:25` (`provider: 'api'`, byte-equal to the emitted string) and `23103:36` (the `'navigation'` first sentence, equal to the emitted one). `pre/22876:29,31` stay byte-equal.
- **`check-empty-changeset` stays red by design (DELIBERATE CORRECTION).** Verdict at `38728b3e1`, verbatim:

```text
This PR changes a changeset it did not add:

   .changeset/23082-view-data-api-provider-retired.md
     present on the merge base and CHANGED by this PR -- this is somebody else's release note
   .changeset/23103-page-action-row-on-success-and-executor.md
     present on the merge base and CHANGED by this PR -- this is somebody else's release note
   .changeset/pre/22876-email-template-category-is-system-retired.md
     present on the merge base and CHANGED by this PR -- this is somebody else's release note
```

  Each note quotes a prescription this PR corrects, and each corrected quote is equal to the emitted text. Restoring any of them from the base would publish a false sentence.
- **Ablation**, each leg restored to blob == HEAD:
  - ⑥ the `'navigation'` refusal without its release: **red**, 1 failed / 18 passed, "names no release". The first try was refused by the tool (the replacement was a substring of the anchor; nothing ran).
  - ⑦ the controlled-by-parent refusal without its release: **red**, 1/18.
- **`main` since:** 9 commits to `6d7f4df3c`. None touches `packages/spec` or adds a `retiredAfter` line; `git merge-tree` with it is clean.
- **Not swept:** two other new D3 narrowings (`page-default-record-page-one-per-object-refused`, `ui-page-action-row-on-success-shape-closed`) whose refusals name no release. They are outside this surface.

## Patch round (seat note 6143582707)

- `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.0` reached npm `next` at 2026-10-13T08:35:43Z, so the changeset's "17.7.0, the newest published release" was false where it is read. It now names 17.7.0 as the newest 17.x release (npm `latest`) and names `18.0.0-next.0` (`56d63b4e7`; the fix round split that sentence per table).
- The next.0 tarball (`npm pack` into its own directory; integrity `sha512-ASTh6…2Ow==` matches the packument) refuses all 16 first-table rows with the text this PR replaces, and the sub-day intervals too. Its `CHANGELOG.md:2091` and `:2093` quote the `email_template` prescriptions as "…17".
- Gates at `56d63b4e7`: 20 derived, 20 run, 19 exit 0, 1 exit 1 (`check-empty-changeset`, by design).

## Landing round (seat review 6140670883)

- **Merge** `071dbdb24` (parents `1ee37155d` and `d889448b9`, the `18.0.0-next.0` version commit), no conflict. The release **moved** `22876` to `.changeset/pre/`; git followed the rename, so the two-line correction sits there.
- **Kept (decision A, seat-confirmed).** At `changeset pre exit` the consumed `pre/` changesets are read again into the stable `18.0.0` CHANGELOG: `@changesets/read@1.0.1` `dist/index.mjs:29`, `@changesets/assemble-release-plan@7.0.0` `dist/index.mjs:328` (drops `pre/` only while `preState.mode !== "exit"`), `@changesets/apply-release-plan@8.1.1` `dist/index.mjs:301-319`.
- **`RETIRED_SUB_DAY_INTERVALS` TSDoc** (`data/analytics.zod.ts:104`, shipped in the `.d.ts`) now reads "declared through @objectstack/spec 17.4.0; 17.5.0 removed them". Docblock text, not a row.
- **`check-issue-citations`**: the one added citation (`#17296`) resolves locally ("1 resolves"); the CI annotation was exit 3, the could-not-measure class.

## Patch round (seat answer 6139390852)

- **Merge.** `7bfd6b035` (parents `936750950` and `20949e7a7`), no conflicts, via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`; `check:generated` green at `1ee37155d`.
- **Row 236, the opposite direction.** `TimeUpdateInterval` accepts `second` / `minute` / `hour` in the 17.4.0 tarball (`src/data/analytics.zod.ts:53-55`) and refuses them in 17.5.0 (`:145-148`); its D2 `cube-sub-day-granularities-removed` is `retiredAfter: '17.4.0'`. The refusal said "retired in protocol 18"; it now says "was removed in @objectstack/spec 17.5.0". It is joined to the pin; its two literal pins follow (`spec/src/data/analytics.test.ts`, `drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics-time-granularity.test.ts`).
- **Pending-changeset quotes, BEFORE → AFTER.** Every quote the sweep read, against each row's verdict. Paths are as read at `e81cae014`; the `18.0.0-next.0` release has since moved each of these files into `.changeset/pre/`:

  No other changeset quotes a changed prescription. The landing round re-swept the remaining root stock and `.changeset/pre/`. The sweep covered every `.changeset/*.md` for each changed sentence and for "17.8.0", "retired in protocol 18", "renamed to `allowEnvironmentOverlay`" and "legacy form of a package manifest". 22876's frontmatter and marker block are byte-identical (first 12 lines, same md5). This PR's own changeset gains the interval correction.

**`check-empty-changeset` stays red by design** (ruling D on #17712, DELIBERATE CORRECTION class): the consumed `pre/22876` note still feeds the stable `18.0.0` notes at pre exit, so restoring it from the base would put a false sentence into them. Decision A, seat-confirmed. The current three-file verdict is in the fix-round section.

## What changed

Eleven prescription strings named the wrong removal release, or none. Ten are for shapes the `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0` tarball still accepts, and they now name 18. The eleventh is the interval refusal above.

- `elementFlatBindingRetired` (`ui/component.zod.ts`): one shared string rendering ten tombstones (`element:number` `object` / `filter`; `element:record_picker` and `element:repeater` `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit`). Was 17.
- `object-grid` `defaultFilters` (`ui/component.zod.ts`). Was 17.
- `email_template.category` and `email_template.isSystem` (`system/email-template.zod.ts`). Was 17.
- The flat permission-string list on a package manifest (`kernel/manifest.zod.ts`, the union arm `ManifestPermissionsSchema` dropped; D2 `manifest-permissions-string-list-removed`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`). Was 17.
- `public` in `StorageScope` (`system/object-storage.zod.ts`, `enumWithRetiredValues`; D3 `storage-scope-public-retired`). Was **17.8.0**, a release this train will not cut.
- `MetadataTypeRegistryEntry.allowOrgOverride` → `allowEnvironmentOverlay` (`kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`). Named **no** release, an omission against the governing text ("the version that removed it"). The seat ratified the edit.
- Fix round: the `'navigation'` row-executor refusal and the controlled-by-parent no-required-master refusal (both named no release), and `view.data.provider: 'api'` (was 17).

Every `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence is unchanged and correct (H6 below). The test files that pinned the old literals follow. The `content/docs/references/**` projection is regenerated (14 rows). One changeset, `@objectstack/spec` patch. One new pin, `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`. The two non-`retiredKey` renderers (manifest list, `StorageScope.public`) and the interval message are seat-ratified surface additions (6139390852).
